techniques.name: Retrieval practice
techniques.requirement: Ask 3-5 closed-book questions before instruction and record first-attempt evidence.

techniques.name: Spaced repetition
techniques.requirement: Schedule deterministic reviews at configured intervals and shorten after failure.

techniques.name: Interleaving
techniques.requirement: Mix due items across domains and avoid more than two same-domain items consecutively.

techniques.name: Elaboration
techniques.requirement: Ask why, how, compare/contrast, and consequence prompts.

techniques.name: Dual coding
techniques.requirement: Include a meaningful diagram, alt text, and a diagram-reconstruction prompt.

techniques.name: Feynman/self-explanation
techniques.requirement: Ask for a novice explanation and score it with a deterministic concept checklist.

techniques.name: Concrete examples
techniques.requirement: Include one worked Azure scenario and one transfer scenario with different surface details.

zpd_levels.scaffolding: Fully worked example, vocabulary, one step at a time
Guided completion, strong hints, partial code
Novel scenario, time pressure, multi-domain integration
